items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: worked with Teddy Bunn and then Slim Galliard in the Spring of '45

ctx.x: Well now, after T-Bone, it says you do Orson Welles radio show, worked with Teddy Bunn
and then Slim Galliard in the Spring of '45.
Yes, that was at Billy Berg's new place. They had moved on Vine Street about this time.
